_description: Window variant: requester in-flight limit W = 1024 (owner-direction limit follows W, -t18-owner-window = 0). Tables default to 2 x W slots. Apply after t18_full.json (or alone for a window-only control). T18 (ISCA'27 new m2, two-sided merge of remote requests). Extends mi200.json; e.g. -config t18_w1024.json. Adds only -t18-* flags to mi200.json; later files in a -config list override earlier ones.
